column1: # XONE:K2 — Allen & Heath "XONE:K2 User Guide" AP8509, MIDI Implementation Send / Return
# The MIDI channel is set by the user (default 15), so every message is listed on all 16 channels.
# Each control has three numbers: red (latching layers off), amber and green layers. For buttons the same
# three notes set the LED to red / amber / green (Return), so button notes are "both". Note names use C-1 = 0.
